rationale: Two major findings: (1) the adapter ignores the boolean return value of delete_managed_budget — non-404 HTTP failures are silently swallowed and logged as 'completed', leaving orphaned budgets with no observable failure signal; (2) the spec-required test test_delete_shared_budget_handles_old_enterprise (covering the AttributeError graceful-degradation path) is missing from the diff. Both are straightforward patches.

business_review.notes: Separate try/except wraps the shared budget call; soft-delete DB writes proceed unconditionally. Confirmed by test_delete_project_budget_shared_budget_failure_does_not_block_soft_delete

standards_review.notes: All new provider calls wrapped in try/except; warnings logged on failure

findings.problem: delete_managed_budget returns False on non-404 HTTP errors, but delete_shared_budget ignores the return value and logs 'shared_budget_delete_completed' regardless. A real HTTP failure (e.g. 500 from LiteLLM) looks identical to a successful delete in logs and metrics.
findings.impact: Orphaned shared budgets survive in LiteLLM after project deletion with no observable failure signal. Operations cannot distinguish success from failure.
findings.recommendation: Capture the return value: result = await asyncio.to_thread(service.delete_managed_budget, budget_id=shared_budget_id). If not result, log a warning instead of the 'completed' debug message.

findings.problem: The spec requires test_delete_shared_budget_handles_old_enterprise to cover the AttributeError graceful-degradation path in delete_shared_budget (when the enterprise service lacks delete_managed_budget). This test is missing from the diff.
findings.impact: If the AttributeError catch is accidentally removed or narrowed in a future refactor, no test will catch the regression against older enterprise deployments.
findings.recommendation: Add: async def test_delete_shared_budget_handles_old_enterprise(): service = MagicMock(spec=[]); adapter = LiteLLMBudgetEnforcementProvider(service=service); await adapter.delete_shared_budget(shared_budget_id='proj:shared') — should complete without raising.
